This examination paper provided a suitable but difficult challenge to the candidates.
Seventeen questions can be said to have been found to be easier. 50% or more of candidates chose the
correct responses to each of Questions 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 12, 13, 14, 19, 25, 27, 28, 30, 31, 32, 37 and 39. Since
Questions 37 and 39 are on this list it can be suggested that most candidates found they had sufficient time
to complete the paper properly.
Five questions can be said to have been found to be particularly difficult. 35% or fewer candidates chose the
correct responses to each of Questions 11, 20, 21, 23, and 33.
